items.title: AWS Certificate Manager now supports ACME issuance through AWS PrivateLink
items.blurb: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) now supports AWS PrivateLink for ACME public certificate issuance, allowing you to request and renew public TLS certificates over a private network path that stays within the AWS network.

items.title: Bidirectional Type Slicing
items.blurb: Abstract: Development tools report what type an expression has, but not why it has that type.

items.title: GLM 5.3 by Z.ai is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports GLM 5.3 from Z.ai, giving you a powerful new option for agentic coding and long-horizon software engineering work.

items.title: Cloudflare Introduces CLI for AI Agents, Sunsetting Wrangler
items.blurb: Cloudflare recently launched the open beta of cf, a new open-source, agent-focused command-line interface for interacting with Cloudflare services through a unified CLI.

items.title: Amazon Redshift adds support for creating and refreshing Apache Iceberg materialized views
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift now supports the creation and refresh of Apache Iceberg materialized views.

items.title: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store
items.blurb: AWS IAM Identity Center helps you configure the single sign-on experience for your workforce to AWS accounts and applications. IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store, which stores your users and groups.

items.title: AWS Control Tower AFT now supports plan-only customization runs
items.blurb: AWS Control Tower Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) now supports plan-only customization runs, giving administrators the ability to preview Terraform changes before applying them across their managed accounts.

items.title: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now supports continuous penetration testing integrated directly into your CI/CD pipeline
items.blurb: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now integrates continuous penetration testing directly into your CI/CD pipeline (public preview) AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing (formerly AWS Security Agent) already provides continuous,…

items.title: Cloudflare Fixes Cross-Tenant Data Exposure in Containers
items.blurb: Cloudflare has disclosed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers and Sandboxes, caused by thin-provisioned storage pools configured to skip zeroing reused blocks.

items.title: Cloudflare Plans Public Certificate Authority to Issue Quantum-Safe TLS Certificates
items.blurb: Cloudflare will operate a free public Certificate Authority to issue quantum-safe Transport Layer Security certificates. This initiative addresses challenges in migrating from classical public key cryptography to post-quantum methods.
